post.summary: Create an agent and its API key
post.description: Returns the plaintext API key once. An idempotent replay returns `apiKey: null`.

get.summary: List the caller's agents, newest first

post.description: The old key stops working at once. Also restores a revoked key. An idempotent replay returns `apiKey: null`.

put.summary: Add a new, unconfirmed mandate version for an agent
put.description: The new version takes effect only after it is confirmed.

post.description: The highest confirmed version is the active mandate.

get.description: An agent sees its owner's wallet plus its own spend today and active mandate rules.

post.summary: Ask to spend from the owner's wallet
post.description: Policy outcomes (allow, pending_approval, deny) are all 201 responses; errors are for bad input, auth or idempotency only.

get.summary: One spend request with its decisions
get.description: An agent sees its own requests; a user sees their agents' requests.

get.summary: Spend requests waiting for the owner, oldest first

post.summary: Approve or deny a pending spend request
post.description: 409 `approval_expired` once the 15 minute window has passed; 409 `already_decided` otherwise.

get.summary: An agent's spend requests, newest first (at most 100)
